contributions.statement: Add a sustained-load soak stage with memory and latency trend tests before releasing agent-generated services, because functional tests do not reveal resource accumulation.
contributions.evidence: §V-A Table I: significant memory upward trend in 11/12 app-environment cells over single 48 h JMeter runs (OS-level RAM); §V-D: human-written comparison apps aged comparably or worse, so nothing is specific to agent-generated code.

reason: Twelve single-run, fully confounded cells and an exploratory human baseline that ages just as much; the takeaway is ordinary soak testing, with no agent-specific finding.
